title: Vikings hire Andrew Healy, Trent Kirchner as assistant GMs

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Vikings hire Andrew Healy, Trent Kirchner as assistant GMs
sources.description: The Vikings are hiring Andrew Healy and Trent Kirchner as assistant General Managers under new General Manager Nolan Teasley, Alec Lewis of TheAthletic.com reports.
